ck_submissions_score.name: ck_submissions_score
ck_submissions_score.value: "assignment_submissions"."score" IS NULL OR "assignment_submissions"."max_score" IS NULL OR "assignment_submissions"."score" <= "assignment_submissions"."max_score"

ck_assignments_window.name: ck_assignments_window
ck_assignments_window.value: "assignments"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "assignments"."due_at" IS NULL OR "assignments"."due_at" > "assignments"."opens_at"

ck_chapter_access_window.name: ck_chapter_access_window
ck_chapter_access_window.value: "chapter_access"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "chapter_access"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "chapter_access"."closes_at" > "chapter_access"."opens_at"
